rows.label: qst630301_msg0001
rows.name: Master... I have a request, mo.

rows.label: qst630301_msg0002
rows.name: Why so formal, mo?

rows.label: qst630301_msg0003
rows.name:
Could it be... You want some of Tora's
Sweet-Sweet Wiener, mo?

rows.label: qst630301_msg0004
rows.name: I don't want that, mo.

rows.label: qst630301_msg0005
rows.name: That was quick, mo!?

rows.label: qst630301_msg0006
rows.name: There's something I want to try, mo.

rows.label: qst630301_msg0007
rows.name: Something you want to try...

rows.label: qst630301_msg0008
rows.name:
A combination of Chanopon and
Sweet-Sweet Wiener, mo?

rows.label: qst630301_msg0009
rows.name: I don't want that either, mo.

rows.label: qst630301_msg0010
rows.name:
How cruel, mo!? Tora was secretly
hoping you would...

rows.label: qst630301_msg0011
rows.name:
What I want to try is a love potion,
mo.

rows.label: qst630301_msg0012
rows.name: Love potion?!

rows.label: qst630301_msg0013
rows.name:
Wh-who are you going to use it on,
mo!?

rows.label: qst630301_msg0014
rows.name: On myself, mo.

rows.label: qst630301_msg0015
rows.name:
A love potion on yourself!? Do you
want to like yourself even more, mo?

rows.label: qst630301_msg0016
rows.name: That's not it, mo.

rows.label: qst630301_msg0017
rows.name:
I'm curious whether that kind of
medicine works on me too, mo.

rows.label: qst630301_msg0018
rows.name: Mo-mo-mo...

rows.label: qst630301_msg0019
rows.name: Tora is curious about that too, mo.

rows.label: qst630301_msg0020
rows.name: All right, let's make one, mo!

rows.label: qst630301_msg0021
rows.name: Master, can you make one, mo?

rows.label: qst630301_msg0022
rows.name:
It's pretty easy once we have the
ingredients, mo.

rows.label: qst630301_msg0024
rows.name: As expected of Master, mo.

rows.label: qst630301_msg0025
rows.name: Ahem, mo!

rows.label: qst630301_msg0026
rows.name:
But gathering the ingredients will be
a little hard, mo...

rows.label: qst630301_msg0027
rows.name: What do we need, mo?

rows.label: qst630301_msg0028
rows.name:
We need several things, but Dokidoki
Shisou is the hardest to get, mo.

rows.label: qst630301_msg0029
rows.name:
It only grows at a place called Sealed
Quarry in Luxuria, mo.

rows.label: qst630301_msg0030
rows.name:
That does sound difficult... Will you
still go get it for me, mo?

rows.label: qst630301_msg0031
rows.name:
Of course, mo! Boss will do most of
the hard work, mo!

rows.label: qst630301_msg0032
rows.name:
Once we have the Dokidoki Shisou, we
just mix it at the hottest place in
Avaritia and it's done, mo!

rows.label: qst630301_msg0033
rows.name: Understood, mo! Let's do our best, mo!
